# Retail CoD 1.5b dedicated server: one player on a ladder.
# map mp_ship, client-probes/probe_ladder under tools/run_probe.sh with +set
# probe_teleport 1, the client --probe-ladder 90 --save-ladder full (recipe in
# crates/gsc/tests/fixtures/semantics/client-probes/README.md, probe_ladder).
# The gsc puts the player at a ladder's foot facing the rungs (mp_ship's hold
# ladder, or probe_spot's); the script starts 1500 ms after the first snapshot
# on the rungs. Phases: (name, ms, forward, right, pitch):
# ladder foot=4332,-93.125,58 yaw=90
#   up-level 2500 127 0 0
#   hang 1000 0 0 0
#   up-look-up 1200 127 0 -45
#   down-back 1500 -127 0 0
#   strafe-right 400 0 127 0
#   drift 600 0 0 0
#   up-strafe-left 600 127 -127 -20
#   release 600 0 0 -20
#   down-look-down 1000 127 0 60
#   up-slight-down 1000 127 0 10
#   up-top 11000 127 0 0
#   off 1000 0 0 0
# !cmd is a usercmd as it went on the wire (angles rebased on delta_angles);
# !snap the playerstate per snapshot, da= its delta_angles. Floats exact.
